answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 155020 Country: India Title: Reading Quran Question: (1) While reading Quran in Mobile phone with wudhu at masjid. Is this good to read Masjid Quran while reciting the Quran in phone? What will be benefit in both the cases? (2) Most of time I pray the namaz with the half sleeves t-shirt. Is this makrooh? Answer ID: 155020 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 28/23/M=1/1439) (1) In this case the better option is to recite from the Quran kept in the mosque. But in case you are in such a place where there is no Quran available then you can recite from the mobile. (2) It is not good. One should offer salah in full sleeve kurta. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
